memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "So Joshua overcame the Amalekite army with the sword." - Ex 17:13 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The victory is recorded in a single line, and it names Joshua.

That is worth noticing. The hands on the hill mattered enormously, but Scripture
still gives Joshua the credit for the fighting. God does not diminish the work
of the person in the valley in order to honour the person praying.

Both are true. God gave the victory, and Joshua fought hard for it. There was
sweat and fear and real danger in that valley all day.

Some Christians struggle to hold these together. Either they work as though

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is this a season for standing still or for taking action?
2. Do you undervalue either prayer or effort in your own life?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, give me wisdom to know when to wait and when to act. Let me work hard and
depend on You completely. Amen.
